script:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== health <existing-healthy-bot> ==='
bash /home/azureuser/bot-health-check.sh <existing-healthy-bot>
echo
echo '=== keitzer files ==='
ls -la /home/azureuser/.keitzer-bot /home/azureuser/keitzer-* /etc/systemd/system/keitzer-*.service 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== <existing-healthy-bot> units ==='
systemctl cat <existing-healthy-bot>-bot.service <existing-healthy-bot>-responder.service
echo
echo '=== <existing-healthy-bot> route ==='
grep -n '<existing-healthy-bot>/api/messages' /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/openclaw-sdneuro 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== listening ports ==='
ss -tlnp | grep -E '127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+' | sort -u
echo
echo '=== bot scripts ==='
ls -1 /home/azureuser/*-{bot.py,responder.py,send-to.sh} 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'
